journey.name: A wrong password is refused
journey.description: Signing in with the wrong password keeps the user on the sign-in screen and says why.

actions.action: Clear the server URL field and type http://10.0.2.2:8971
Tap the "Username" field and type admin
Tap the "Password" field and type not-the-password
Verify that the sign-in screen is still shown, with an error message containing "Login failed" under the password field
Verify that the "Connect" button can be tapped again
